note: Pending means not yet reviewed against the current rules. Structural checks alone never count as editorial review. Preserve user-approved Spanish sets.

entries.reason: Both source occurrences are participles of venir: « la bise fut venue », « la nuit venue ». They are incorrectly linked to the noun arrival. Requires occurrence-level semantic reassignment with preserved history.

All three source occurrences are feminine adjective nouvelle (saison/rivière/peine), but the record is a noun with news gloss and short-story definition. Must split/reassign lexical identity before quiz approval.
Source « avant l’août » uses historical harvest time, not simply the modern month. Current gloss conflates both. Resolve the contextual sense before authoring an August calendar quiz.
Shared source identity combines « foi d’animal » (pledged word) with « feront foi » (attestation/evidence). One pledge quiz set would teach the second occurrence incorrectly.

Source « intérêt et principal » means loan interest, while the linked sense is advantage/benefit. Financial charge is a distinct meaning requiring semantic identity correction, not a silent quiz rewrite.
Historical « chercher aventure » is annotated as seeking a quarrel. Modern travel/adventure contexts would change the sense; resolve this phrase-specific usage before approving replacement questions.
Both occurrences (« ne se mette », « que je me mette ») are subjunctive mettre. The imported noun bread chest is wrong. Preserve old history and plan fresh correct semantic identity.

The occurrences are adjectival « l’an passé » and verbal « s’étoit passé ». Neither supports the linked noun, whose past-tense gloss also conflicts with its elapsed-time definition. Requires a sense/POS split.
Both source occurrences (« je n’étais pas », « tu ne t’en étais pas aperçue ») are être, not plural construction supports. A noun quiz would reinforce an imported homograph error.
The everyone meaning belongs to the whole expression « tout le monde », not isolated monde. Current single-word gloss/identity should be resolved against the expression model before approval.
Archaic « d’un Rat eût affaire » means need of help, while modern avoir affaire is broader dealings. Needs phrase/lexical review before using modern affair/business quizzes.
Shared point identity combines timely à point with numerous negative ne…point occurrences. Correct per-occurrence meaning before approving a timely-moment quiz.
Source « les renvoie aux calendes » is a figurative distant/postponed date. Current questions teach only literal Roman calendar facts. Resolve the phrase-specific sense before approval.

This reason identity combines avoir raison (being right) and raison d’État with causal-motive quizzes. Source meanings require explicit lexical/phrase separation; the existing early answer even combines reason and right.
Existing early answer closed doors translates the whole expression à huis clos, not target huis (door). Review the expression/component treatment and archaic independent usage before approving.

Source sous combines preposition (sous terre, sous la pression) with plural coin noun (cinq sous la page), while its lemma is classified as noun and its sense as preposition. Split/reassign occurrences before questions.
Source sous le coup des articles de la loi denotes legal applicability, while current quizzes use emotional shock. Resolve these contextual meanings before approving one shared quiz set.
The sense is defined solely by the historical Dreyfus document. New generic packing-list contexts would silently broaden it; resolve the reusable document sense versus historical note first.
The target is the bound component lèse-humanité in crime de lèse-humanité, while its gloss translates the whole crime. Resolve expression/component identity before standalone noun questions.

The historical lettre-télégramme needs its communication format and contextual sense verified before writing three precise contexts. Its generic near-telegram definition is insufficient to distinguish it reliably from other urgent letters.

Like lèse-humanité, lèse-justice appears as a bound compound in crime de lèse-justice. Verify the component-versus-whole-expression meaning and grammatical classification before standalone noun quiz approval.
Source d’une part/d’autre part is a discourse expression. Resolve how the independently tested component part should represent aspect/side without silently changing to a food-portion or share sense.

Historical carte-télégramme in the Esterhazy evidence requires verification: the current transmitted-by-telegraph definition may incorrectly describe a pneumatic postal card. Preserve identity pending source-supported correction.

Mixed occurrence meanings: tout à coup/tout d’un coup suddenness, wand blows, and a midnight clock stroke share a sudden-event sense. Requires explicit occurrence-level semantic separation before approving any quiz set.
All source uses of sabre stand for military power or militarism, whereas the identity defines a physical weapon only. Clarify figurative sense and mapping before approving literal weapon questions.

Source bureau includes an administrative service and the husband being at his office in La Parure. Current service-only definition and quizzes do not cover both occurrences; explicit sense split needed.

Royal Court in Cendrillon is incorrectly assigned the judicial-court sense used in Zola. Split royal entourage from court of law by occurrence; also remove yard as a legitimate alternate meaning from English distractors.
Source paralysie générale refers to a specific historical illness, not merely generic loss of movement. Verify the historical sense before approving generic medical quizzes.
Only source is en fin de compte, a discourse expression meaning ultimately. Numerical count questions do not test that use; decide component/expression mapping before approval.
Shared sense conflates organized persecution in Zola with recreational hunting in La Parure. Explicitly split the hunting occurrence and prepare separate quiz identities.

Passions de réaction in Zola denotes political reaction/opposition to progress, not a generic response to a stimulus. Separate or specify the political sense before approving everyday reaction questions.
Peuple includes the entire nation in Zola and the common/socially lower classes in filles du peuple and femme du peuple in La Parure. Current inhabitants-only sense needs explicit separation.

Chambre includes chamber of deliberation in Zola and domestic rooms in Cendrillon; definition restricts it to people meeting, and existing assembly quizzes add an unsupported political context. Review broader room sense vs separate chamber use.

Only source de son côté means for his part/on his own side, while current questions test spatial right/left. Sense allows viewpoint but not this specific distribution of action; review component vs expression identity.
Source existence mixes actual presence of a document with entire lifetime in La Parure. Current definition presence only needs separate life sense before approval.
Prendre en main managerial control and literal donner la main in Cendrillon share one control sense; split the physical hand occurrence without resetting existing control mastery.

Assises question currently depends entirely on fixed cour d’assises construction with singular incompatible distractors. Review treatment as expression/component and find plural feminine alternatives that do not make grammar select the answer.
Includes noun faculty of sight, noun sight of someone, and participle vue in je ne t’ai vue. The participle must be reassigned to voir and the two noun uses reviewed explicitly.

Source l’œuf est ici figuratively identifies a germ/origin, while the egg identity embeds a source-specific metaphor. Review whether literal egg quiz plus expression teaching or a dedicated figurative sense is intended; do not substitute definition frames.
Sceaux occurs only in garde des sceaux, a ministerial title. Quizzing literal official seals would not establish comprehension of the title; expression/component identity needs explicit review.
Feu combines armed combat in Zola and a household heating fire in La Parure. Separate the latter from combat before reviewing both sets.
Judicial instruction in Zola is conflated with ministère de l’instruction publique in La Parure. Reuse existing education sense/identity where applicable and explicitly reassign occurrence.
In La Parure, pas d’espérances following pas de dot may specifically mean expected inheritance, rather than generic hopes. Verify historical contextual meaning before approval.
Race in this nineteenth-century social context may mean lineage or inherited rank. Avoid replacing with modern racial-group teaching without historical lexical verification.
Usure is both wear of furniture and excessive loan interest in taux de l’usure. Split financial usury from wear using explicit occurrence mapping.
Sièges in La Parure means pieces of furniture, but its sense incorrectly specifies judges’ seats in court. Reuse correct seat/furniture sense and preserve unrelated judicial identity.
Masculine plural amis is attached to a female-only amie sense. Reuse or create an appropriately shared friendship lemma/sense and masculine plural surface; do not approve feminine-only definition.
Sphinx is reduced to enigmatic face in current definition while source uses sourire de sphinx metaphor. Verify mythological/figurative lexical treatment before writing precise questions.
Gélinotte is a specific bird species, while existing definition only says wild bird served as game. Obtain a reliable lexical identification and distinguish it from other game birds before approval.
Soirée includes both evening interval and social evening event in La Parure. Current time-only definition needs event sense review, not approval of one set for all occurrences.
Source invitation is the physical invitation/card thrown onto a table; current action-of-inviting definition needs message/document sense rather than substituting abstract action quizzes.
Tu ne sors jamais is sortir present second-person singular, not a falconry noun. Replace lexical identity with explicit occurrence migration.
Peine occurrences express difficulty, sorrow, and worry; none matches the imported punishment-only definition. Separate contextual meanings and preserve correct existing identities.
Modern Paris theatre is assigned an ancient open-air semicircular building definition. Correct the building/performance-venue sense before quiz approval.
Coins des yeux/de la bouche are corners, not wedges for splitting wood. Reassign to appropriate corner sense.
Toilette means elegant outfit in all source occurrences, not the historical small cloth imported as its definition. Reuse correct outfit sense with singular surface.
Sera is être future third-person singular, not a language name. Explicit lexical correction required.
Somme is amount of money, not necessarily mathematical sum. Source monetary sense needs correction rather than arithmetic questions.
Fusil is hunting firearm in La Parure, not a fire steel. Correct lexical identity and use neutral quiz contexts.
Tâche d’avoir is imperative tâcher, not noun task. Reassign to verb identity.
Inquiète is a predicative feminine adjective, not a noun person. Correct POS/lemma/sense identity.
Anxieuse is a predicative feminine adjective, not noun person. Correct POS/lemma/sense identity.
Prête means ready, feminine adjective; imported barrel-binding noun is wholly wrong. Explicit semantic migration required.
Es is être present second-person singular, not a Cyrillic letter name. Separate lexical identity required.
Pierre means gemstone to wear in this passage, not geological rock mass. Reassign to precious-stone sense.
Auras is avoir future second-person singular, not plural aura. Explicit lexical migration required.
Glace means mirror in all source occurrences, not frozen water. Reuse mirror sense where available and preserve ice identity elsewhere.
Croix refers to a cross-shaped jewel, while definition gives only abstract intersection. Review object sense and symbol before approving abstract crossing questions.
Vénitienne is adjective modifying croix, not a silk fabric noun. Correct Venetian-origin adjective identity.
As is avoir present second person, including auxiliary uses, not playing-card ace. Separate lexical verb and auxiliary senses where required.
Satin source is the shiny fabric lining a box, while imported definition is technical weave structure. Clarify material sense and use textile-specific questions without overtechnical scaffolding.
Rivière means diamond necklace throughout La Parure, not a natural watercourse. Explicit jewelry sense and occurrence migration required.
Montante modifies robe and means high-necked; not a noun for underwear. Correct adjective identity.
Source emportement is passionate exuberance, not anger; imported circular definition action de s’emporter does not clarify the intended sense. Correct contextual sense before quiz approval.
Son trésor is the cherished borrowed necklace, not hoarded gold/silver. Expand or separate figurative treasured object sense with explicit mapping.
Élégante is predicate adjective, not noun an elegant woman. Correct adjective identity.
Folle is feminine adjective in folle de joie and bien folle, not a fishing net. Review emotional exaggeration and foolishness meanings explicitly.
Cabinet means ministerial staff/office in attachés du cabinet, not a small secluded room. Correct government-office sense.
Ivresse is figurative exhilaration in dancing, not physical drunkenness. Define and map the figurative sense.
Sorte mixes a kind/type in une sorte de and connective de sorte que in Cendrillon. Review expression-component treatment and contextual questions.
Nuage de bonheur is a figurative enveloping state, not atmospheric droplets. Correct or document the metaphorical sense before approval.
Hommages are admiring attentions in ballroom context. Imported sexual-act definition is contextually wrong and must be replaced with the appropriate respect/admiration sense.
Complète is adjective agreeing with victoire, not a galette noun. Correct POS and sense.
Douce is adjective describing victory as pleasing, not an affectionate noun. Correct adjective sense.
Noctambules modifies coupés metaphorically as active at night; not noun sleepwalkers. Correct adjective sense and part of speech.
Poches are garment pockets, not generic flexible bags/containers. Correct contextual garment-pocket sense.
Perdue is feminine past participle of perdre, not noun a mad woman. Correct verb identity and meaning.
Aurions is avoir conditional first-person plural auxiliary, not fish noun. Explicit correction required.
Entendue is entendre past participle feminine, not noun a self-important woman. Explicit correction required.
Préfecture de police is a police administrative institution, not an ancient Roman office. Correct modern French institutional sense.
Compagnies de petites voitures are businesses, not social gatherings. Correct company-enterprise sense.
Figure mixes face in La Parure and social prominence in faisoient grande figure in Cendrillon; imported external shape definition misses both contextual meanings.
Espérance is ordinary hope in this passage; imported definition incorrectly restricts contrast with espoir to eschatology. Correct definition before approval.
Livres means business/account ledgers used to check a sale, not general books for reading. Review specialized account-book sense or broader existing definition.
Pareille is adjective same/similar and nominal matching shoe, not socially equal peers. Separate usages and correct POS.
Chapelet de diamants is a string/series of gems, not floral crown. Correct string/series sense.
Faire condition is stipulating a contractual condition, not generic nature/state/quality. Correct condition-as-stipulation sense.
Billets means promissory notes/debt instruments, not informal letters. Correct financial sense.
Engagements means binding financial commitments; imported action of engaging is vague/circular. Clarify obligation sense before approval.
Toutes les races de prêteurs means all sorts/kinds of lenders, not family lineages. Correct figurative category sense.
Risquer sa signature refers to credit/financial obligation behind signing. Current handwritten-name definition may not teach this metonymy; clarify contextual sense.
Imported angoisses definition mandates physical medical symptoms not present in anxiety about the future. Reuse ordinary intense-worry sense and correct overmedicalized definition.
Noire modifies misère, figuratively dire/deep; not a quarter-note noun. Correct adjective identity.
Perspective means prospect of future deprivation, not geometric perspective. Correct future-outlook sense.
Déposant is present participle of déposer putting money on counter, not noun witness/deponent. Correct lexical identity.
Prise is prendre past participle feminine in prendre pour, not noun ability to grasp. Correct verb sense mistake/regard as.
Bonne mixes domestic-servant noun in La Parure with multiple adjective meanings in Cendrillon (kind, skilled, fitting, bonne grâce). Explicitly split by POS and context.
Besognes de la cuisine denotes cooking/kitchen work, while current definition only names room. Review activity vs location sense before approval.
Poteries means ceramic vessels being washed, not the pottery craft. Correct plural manufactured-object sense.
S’arrêtant is present participle of reflexive s’arrêter, not a stop mechanism noun. Correct lexical identity.
Imported bras definition restricts it to upper arm while source panier au bras likely involves whole arm/forearm. Correct everyday anatomical sense before approval.
Injuriée is past participle/adjectival passive receiving insults, not nominal recipient. Correct POS and identity.
Sou is nineteenth-century small coin, not medieval gold coin; reuse newly reviewed small-coin sense from sous semantic migration.
Argent conflates money in La Parure and silver material in Cendrillon. Separate monetary occurrence from metallic silver.
Dura is durer simple past third singular, not a Himalayan language. Correct verb identity.
Taux denotes interest rate, not state-fixed price. Correct rate sense and preserve financial distinctions.
Intérêts means loan charges, not benefits or interests of a person. Reuse corrected financial interest sense where possible.
Vieille is predicative adjective, not noun elderly woman. Correct adjective identity.
Devenue is devenir past participle, not noun future development. Correct verbal identity.
Dure is adjective of harsh/tough woman, not substantivized noun. Correct adjective and contextual meaning.
Ménages pauvres means poor households, not domestic administration/chores. Correct household sense.
Mal peignée means hair badly combed; not noun rough beating. Correct past participle/adjective peigner.
De travers means crooked/askew; current width noun definition does not teach source expression. Correct expression/component sense.
Changeante describes life as changing/unpredictable, not noun variable star. Correct adjective identity.
Allée is aller past participle feminine, not noun act of going. Correct verbal identity.
Bourgeoise is used for the apparent ordinary common woman who addresses Mme Forestier, not necessarily an affluent proud woman. Imported judgment-laden definition needs historical contextual review.
Durs is plural adjective meaning difficult for days, not penal-colony noun. Correct adjective.
Misères are hardships/troubles experienced, not a single pitiful state; clarify plural hardships sense.
Prêtée is prêter past participle feminine, not noun loaned object. Correct verbal identity.
Avions is avoir imperfect first plural, not airplanes. Correct lexical verb identity.
Orgueilleuse modifies joie; adjective, not noun proud woman. Correct adjective identity.
Humeur means temperament and mood in Cendrillon, not bodily fluid. Separate appropriate psychological senses.
De son costé is for his part, not anatomical rib region. Review old-spelling côté expression identity.
Sans exemple means unparalleled, whereas supplied example-as-model definition does not cover precedent/comparison. Review precedent sense or expression identity.
Meilleure is superlative adjective modifying personne, not noun the best-ranked woman. Correct adjective sense.
Personne includes human-being noun and negative pronoun ne…personne in Cendrillon. Split negative-pronoun occurrence.
Belle-mere is stepmother, not mother-in-law, in Cendrillon. Correct family relation.
Souffrir is a verb with tolerate and undergo suffering uses, not nominal infinitive action. Separate meanings and POS.
Occupations means household tasks, not military occupations. Correct activity sense.
Celles is feminine plural demonstrative pronoun referring to rooms, not Roman bath compartments. Correct POS.
Grenier is attic used as bedroom, not specifically grain store. Correct attic sense.
Méchante describes poor-quality paillasse, not cruel-person noun. Correct adjective and bad/inferior sense.
Cendrillon calls step-sisters sœurs, whereas definition strictly demands both shared parents. Correct inclusive literary kinship usage without falsely assigning biological parentage.
À la mode means fashionable, not generic manner of seeing/acting. Correct fashion sense.
Grondée is gronder past participle feminine, not noun reprimand. Correct verb identity.
Coin is corner/side of fireplace, not wedge. Reuse correct spatial corner sense.
Personnes de qualité means people of noble/high social rank, not generic property/characteristic. Correct high-rank sense.
Damoiselles are unmarried young women of standing, not wives of damoiseaux. Imported marital definition conflicts with story. Correct historical title.
Aises in bien aises is plural feminine adjective glad, not noun joys. Correct adjective identity.
Barriere is a rare historical forehead jewel; precise shape and nomenclature need a reliable lexical source before creating distinguishable jewel alternatives.
Cornettes à deux rangs is specific historical headwear; verify physical form before distinguishing it from other hairstyles/head coverings.
Goût is aesthetic judgment in clothing, not sense of taste. Correct aesthetic taste sense.
Conseilla is conseiller simple past third singular, not noun adviser. Correct verb identity.
Aise in bien aise is adjective glad, not noun pleasure; correct POS and expression usage.
Joye is ordinary intense happiness; imported definition incorrectly restricts joy to philosophical/spiritual progress. Correct ordinary joy sense.
Lacets are garment laces used to tighten waists, not animal snares. Correct clothing-lace sense.
Taille means waist, not cutting or cut style. Correct body waist sense.
Écorce is outer rind of pumpkin, not woody bark. Correct fruit rind sense.
Carosse is historical spelling of carrosse, not fruit. Correct carriage lemma/sense/surface.
Trappe belongs to mousetrap, not a floor-level door; imported definition overly restricts location. Correct trap-door/lid sense.
Maîtresse is adjective meaning large/remarkable before barbe, though imported POS is noun. Correct adjective identity preserving reviewed historical meaning.
Drap d’or et d’argent means woven cloth, not bed sheet. Correct textile material sense.
Princesse is royal/noble rank in source, not demonstrably daughter of reigning monarch. Broaden or separate accurate title sense before quiz approval.
Bruit is an indistinct murmur of admiration, not necessarily an unpleasant sound. Correct overrestrictive unpleasant-only definition.
Ha is exclamatory interjection, not Arabic letter. Correct POS/meaning.
Reine includes royal consort and attained queen status, not necessarily reigning monarch. Correct title sense without inventing ruling power.
Reverence is curtsy/bow gesture, not abstract veneration. Correct physical courtesy sense.
Arrivée is arriver past participle feminine, not arrival noun. Correct verb identity.
Envie de dormir is desire, not envy of another’s advantages. Correct desire sense.
Ennuyée is past participle/adjective bored, not noun someone in trouble. Correct s’ennuyer and contextual meaning.
Mademoiselle addresses an unmarried young woman in story; imported definition says married woman and cites later century. Correct historical title meaning.
Esté is historical être past participle, not ester molecule. Correct verb/auxiliary occurrences explicitly.
Sœur refers to stepsister, while definition strictly requires shared parents. Reconcile literary kinship with sœurs case before approval.
Se leva is se lever simple past, not Bulgarian currency. Correct reflexive verb.
Estant is historical étant, present participle of être used as auxiliary, not ester molecule. Correct lexical identity.
Palais means royal palace, not roof of mouth. Correct building sense.
Princesses title need not mean daughters of reigning sovereign; synchronize corrected broad royal-title sense with singular Princesse.
Duchesses title may be held independently or by marriage; source does not identify husbands. Correct wife-only definition before contextual quiz approval.
Cire in juste comme de cire uses molding wax as comparison, not a specified ethylene-glycol ester. Correct ordinary wax definition and expression meaning.
Poche is garment pocket, not generic flexible container. Correct with plural poches case.
Maria is marier simple past third singular, not a language. Correct causative marry-off sense.
Seigneurs de la Cour designates nobles/lords, not necessarily territorial sovereigns. Correct court-title sense.
Le sexe in moral means womankind/the female sex, not abstract biological attribute. Correct historical collective sense.
Tresor figuratively means precious valuable quality, not hoarded physical riches. Review with trésor case and preserve old spelling.
Dressant is dresser present participle meaning educating/training, not mining coal seam. Correct verb sense.
Don of grace from fairies combines gift and innate/endowed quality. Current property-transfer definition needs explicit contextual endowed-quality sense review.
Talens means talents/abilities, not weight of an ingot. Correct aptitude sense with historical surface.
Ciel denotes providence/divine source of gifts, not physical space containing stars. Correct figurative religious sense.
Recevoir en partage means receive as one’s lot/endowment, not division into portions. Review expression identity or contextual lot sense.
Parrains in the moral are patrons/sponsors who help advancement, not necessarily baptismal godfathers. Clarify patronage sense.
Maraines in moral extends fairy godmothers to social patrons; baptism-only definition needs contextual patronage review.
La identity includes definite article and direct-object pronoun occurrences under the meaning the. Separate article/pronoun assignments before approving one quiz set.
Ayant is present participle avoir, with lexical and auxiliary uses; sense incorrectly defines avait imperfect third singular. Correct shared metadata and usages.
Tout includes determiner, pronoun and intensifying adverb (tout frais, tout entier, tout à coup) under determiner every/all. Audit occurrence-level grammatical roles.
L’ combines elided definite article and direct-object pronoun under article the; requires separation.
Été is être past participle, but shared sense says are and conflates copula/auxiliary uses. Correct metadata and roles before approving.
Se is unelided reflexive/pronominal marker, but definition incorrectly specifies elided form. Correct metadata and distinguish reflexive/reciprocal/inherent-pronominal uses as needed.
Trouva includes se trouver in a state, discovering mice, and judging someone beautiful; current find-searched-object definition covers only one. Explicit sense separation.

Fut includes copular and auxiliary simple past, with historical unaccented imperfect-subjunctive use possible in croyoit pas qui fut onze heures; shared definition are is incorrect. Review form and senses.
Lui includes indirect object to him/her and stressed pronoun with lui/vers lui. Definition to him fails feminine and stressed uses. Correct metadata and explicit mappings.
Prêter in sources means lend with expected return; imported fournir, donner definition obscures loan vs gift. Correct lending sense.
Subsister refers to supporting life with food; definition only continued existence of things explicitly excludes animate subject. Correct live-on/survive sense.

Dit combines present, simple past, past participle, and expressive dire uses under says. Surface may legitimately share lemma sense but inflected metadata must represent tense ambiguity; review exact role before approval.
Est shared sense says are and conflates copula/auxiliary roles. Correct invariant lemma sense instead of incorrect tense translation.
Que includes interrogative what and optative subjunctive que Votre Majesté..., while definition describes one specific rhetorical question. Separate grammatical uses.
Que faisiez-vous asks what activity, not specifically creating/manufacturing material objects. Correct generic do sense.
Déplaise in ne vous déplaise is a polite concessive/optative formula, and imported definition restricts subject to persons. Correct dislike/displease event sense and expression coverage.

En preposition sense contains pronominal en (j’en suis aise, en veut, en donne) and gerund marker occurrences. Reassign appropriate pronoun usages to existing pronoun en and review grammatical marker.
Suis is être first singular present, but sense are incorrect. Correct shared metadata before reauthoring templates.
Bien includes emphatic indeed, degree very, manner well and Eh bien connective; narrow emphasis definition does not cover all. Separate source uses.
Ce includes demonstrative determiner and independent demonstrative pronoun in ce n’est/ce qui/ce que. Split grammatical identities or explicitly broaden with role-safe quizzes.
Du mixes contraction de+le, partitive du secours, and proper-name particle du Paty. Correct occurrence roles before approval.
Que exclamation sense contains interrogative/relative/complement/comparison/restrictive constructions. Extensive occurrence reassignment needed; do not approve under one exclamation meaning.
Êtes copular and auxiliary forms use shared être sense are; coordinate consistent lemma metadata/role correction with other être forms rather than approving one while others remain false.
Me includes indirect, direct and reflexive usages under to me. Define accurate roles and separate where necessary.
Si combines conditional if, intensifier so, indirect whether and affirmative si. Separate occurrences before approval.
Reopened coverage audit: reused target received reviewed questions, but its original source occurrences still require complete lexical review.
Des contraction sense contains indefinite plural article des bracelets/des billets/des mouches and others. Separate indefinite uses to correct identity.
Ces definition says this rather than plural these/those; correct metadata and generic demonstrative lemma sense.
Il includes referential he/it and impersonal il faut/il y a/il s’agit. Define impersonal role explicitly rather than solely he.
S’ reflexive marker sense incorrectly includes elided si in s’ils/s’il. Explicitly reassign conditional occurrences and review pronominal constructions.
Que includes relative object que la faim attirait and comparative plus petit que soi under subordinate that. Separate grammatical senses.
Vit mixes vivre present lives with voir simple past saw, including saw bracelets. Separate homographs.
Elided direct object l’ is singular; definition incorrectly includes replacing multiple people/things and POS merges article/pronoun. Correct metadata and audit assignments.
Confus mixes embarrassed person with indistinct sound bruit confus; separate meanings.
Elided qu’ mixes complement, comparison autant qu’on peut, purpose pour qu’elle and imperative qu’on cherche. Review grammatical senses.
Y includes location, complement penser à, and existential il y a under only that way/situation. Separate roles and fix definition.
Prendrait includes catching by a ruse and taking measures; split meanings.
Plus includes comparative greater degree as well as no longer; negative-only definition does not cover occurrences.
Allons in allons montrer is near-future auxiliary, not moving to a place. Correct sense assignment.
Troubler includes muddying water and disturbing emotions; current agitation/inquiétude definition does not adequately distinguish physical water sense.
Plein includes full of anger and plein jour (broad daylight); container-only meaning too narrow for latter.
Seras in seras châtié is passive auxiliary, not merely defining a state. Coordinate être auxiliary/copula mapping.
Historical first-person je vas with progressive allant construction needs dedicated historical-form editorial treatment; modern tu vas quizzes would test the wrong form.
Conséquent occurs in par conséquent therefore, not rational/consistent adjective. Treat expression component accurately.
Reprit here resumed speaking; definition take again wrong sense.
Bête includes animal noun under stupid adjective. Separate POS/senses.
L’aurais combines object pronoun and auxiliary in one vocabulary token; decide compound-token treatment and correct misleading would have it meaning before quiz approval.
Encor is only defined as spelling variant; source still suckling versus even better need semantic definitions and assignment.
Ton also precedes feminine amie before a vowel; masculine-only definition incorrect. Correct determiner metadata.
Tiens combines presenting imperative and possessive les tiens. Split homographs.
Là-dessus in narrative means thereupon, not literal on that. Correct discourse meaning.
Autant in autant qu’on peut indicates extent as much as, not d’autant plus increasing degree. Correct sense.
Deux cardinal numeral incorrectly labelled verb. Correct metadata before approving number questions.
Les includes definite article and direct-object pronoun (les renvoie) under meaning the. Separate grammatical assignments.
Assez à l’étourdie is rather/quite heedlessly, not enough. Distinguish degree from sufficient quantity.
Relative-object qu’ includes complement of être ce qu’il était and consequential tant...qu’une maille under object relative. Correct roles; POS says conjunction despite pronoun definition.
Était defined as are; correct tense metadata and copula/auxiliary roles.
Donna la vie spared life, donna un bal hosted an event, donna une paire gave an object; single property-transfer definition does not cover all.
Eût includes imperfect subjunctive eût affaire and literary conditional-perfect alternative elle eût désiré. Define auxiliary uses accurately before approving.
Le direct-object singular definition incorrectly says one or more; also neutral proposition le répète. Correct metadata and roles.
Font shares definition referring to fait and faire des pas, but occurrences accomplish/make for oneself/transform into. Correct faire senses.
Partir includes à partir de, from/starting from; departure quizzes do not cover expression usage. Review assignments.
Commère noun incorrectly labelled verb; familiar address and gossip meanings also conflated.
Quatre cardinal number incorrectly tagged verb.
Ellébore plant noun incorrectly tagged verb. Fix before noun-only agreement-safe distractors.
Non negative adverb incorrectly tagged verb; gap also allows oui.
Fait action sense includes se fait fort and il ne fait pas bon, beyond faire des pas definition. Repair shared faire mappings.
Causative fait includes fait des bureaux l’arche, transformation without infinitive, under specifically fait arpenter. Clarify causal/transformation roles.
Mit includes lexical put and se mit à inchoative began. Split usage.
Quel includes exclamative quel nid/quel coup as well as interrogative which. Define and map roles.
Faire generic infinitive carries narrow definition fait makes/takes in faire des pas; many causal/idiomatic constructions need accurate sense metadata.
Ceux defined as singular the one; correct plural meaning these/those/the ones.
Être infinitive defined as are, includes passive auxiliary/copying state. Correct metadata and roles.
